objective: Review and verify the B0 evidence/profile phase as an integrated set. Confirm B0.1–B0.3 receipts, their reviewer-agent outcomes, contract checks and retained evidence boundaries; do not approve clinical parameters or mark the birthing specification approved.
steps: Check B0.1, B0.2 and B0.3 acceptance markers against their exact implementation commits, reviewer-agent assessments and evidence receipts.
Verify the B0.2 profile remains source-versioned, reference-only and explicit about unavailable site parameters and source conflicts.
Verify B0.3 profile contract tests include malformed and semantic negative controls and preserve unresolved data boundaries.
Rerun the exact profile test file and repository Conductor context/task integrity checks; capture toolchain, exact command results and scope limits.
Obtain independent reviewer-agent phase review of the exact candidate commit; address findings before coordinator marks B0.4 accepted.

verification.oracle: B0.4 packet base, inputs and accepted B0.3 dependency validate.
All profile source contract and negative-control tests execute and pass.
Conductor links and phase structure remain valid after B0 acceptance updates.

acceptance: B0.1, B0.2 and B0.3 are individually checked and accepted with exact reviewer-agent findings/remediation recorded.
All B0 implementation evidence and checks are reproducible; unresolved sources, correlations, site parameters and clinical applicability remain explicit.
Birthing track remains proposed and spec_approved=false; this B0 phase closeout makes no clinical, operational or runtime claim.
Fresh reviewer-agent phase review of the exact candidate commit finds no unresolved actionable issues.
stop_conditions: Any B0 task lacks exact acceptance evidence
Any edit escapes the exact write paths
